nphi.title: UNITED4Surveillance – Union and National Capacity Building for Integrated Surveillance
nphi.with: Norwegian Institute of Public Health (WP lead); Robert Koch Institute; Statens Serum Institut; THL; AGES; NVSC Lithuania; SZÚ Czechia; ECDC; Ukraine (observer country)
nphi.summary: EU4Health Joint Action of ~40 public health institutes from 24 countries, coordinated by RIVM, to strengthen integrated infectious disease surveillance (outbreak detection, hospital surveillance, One Health); Norway's NIPH co-leads work…

nphi.title: EU Twinning: Strengthening Blood Safety System in Georgia
nphi.actor: Lithuanian consortium (National Blood Centre, Vilnius University, National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory) with Sanquin (Netherlands)
nphi.with: National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Ministry of IDPs, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia
nphi.summary: EU Twinning launched in September 2020 that revised Georgia's blood-safety legal framework, assessed blood banks and supported reorganising transfusion services and lab capacity with NCDC Georgia.

nphi.title: EU Twinning: Enhance national disease surveillance in Georgia through improved epidemiological and molecular (genomic) surveillance
nphi.actor: Lithuanian consortium led by Vilnius University Hospital Santaros Klinikos (with National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory, Health Emergency Situations Centre, National Blood Center, CPVA)
nphi.with: L. Sakvarelidze National Center for Disease Control and Public Health (NCDC); Ministry of IDPs, Labour, Health and Social Affairs of Georgia
nphi.summary: Lithuanian-led EU Twinning (EUR 1.2 million) strengthening NCDC Georgia's epidemiological and genomic surveillance in line with EU rules under the Association Agreement.

nphi.title: Enhancing Georgia's National Disease Surveillance System (twinning)
nphi.actor: Lithuanian National Public Health Surveillance Laboratory (with Vilnius University Hospital Santaros Klinikos)
nphi.with: Georgian national disease surveillance institutions (not named on page); Health Emergency Situations Centre; National Blood Centre (Lithuania)
nphi.summary: EU twinning led by Lithuanian health institutions to build genomic surveillance of infectious diseases in Georgia in line with EU recommendations.
